defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity (Stinger Only)
defensiveAbilities.description:
Stinger only

See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Formic Acid Spray
offensiveAbilities.description: The red guard ant sprays a 15ft Cone of acid from its abdomen that deals 10d10 Acid Damage damage (Basic DC 34 Reflex Saving Throw). It can't use Formic Acid Spray again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Haul Away
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The red guard ant has a Huge or smaller creature Grabbed

Effect The ant Strides up to its full Speed, carrying the grabbed creature with it. It's encumbered if the grabbed creature is Large or larger.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pack Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: A red guard ant deals an additional 2d6 precision damage to any creature within reach of at least two of the ant's allies.

offensiveAbilities.name: Red Ant Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 36 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 3d6 Poison Damage damage and Enfeebled 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 4d6 Poison Damage damage and Enfeebled 2 (1 round)

Stage 3 6d6 Poison Damage damage and Enfeebled 3 (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Swarming Flank
offensiveAbilities.description: If at least three red guard ants have a creature within their reach, they flank the creature, even if they can't draw a line to each other that passes through opposite sides of the creature's space.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
